questions.stem: A 74-year-old female presented with sudden onset pain and swelling in the left knee. On examination she is afebrile. X-ray shows chondrocalcinosis. Microscopic analysis of the synovial fluid is most likely to show:

options.label: C
options.text: Rhomboidal, weakly positive refringent crystals under polarising microscopy

options.label: D
options.text: Needle shaped, strongly negative birefringent crystals under polarising microscopy
